budget_items.topic: Reserves and subsidy, May 2021 financial report
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reserves were at 99.78%, with a warning not to let them reach 100% or the subsidy is lost; projects being considered to bring reserves down include a maintenance tractor with snow plow and snow blower.
budget_items.quote: reserves are at 99.78%, we should not let this go to 100% or we lose subsidy.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Shelter rents were a little below due to a few vacancies; nothing was budgeted for extraordinary maintenance.
budget_items.quote: five months in, shelter rents a little below due to a few vacancies.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of the age of appliances and replacing them on a rotating basis to help bring down reserves; no amount stated.
budget_items.quote: discussion on age of appliances and whether to replace on rotating basis to help bring down reserves.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A grant was received under the PHN 2021-02 NOFA as a regional award for Lunenburg, Sterling and W. Boylston; hours are to be added to the Leominster RSC. No dollar amount printed.
budget_items.quote: we submitted an application and received grant for lunenburg, sterling and w. boylston (regional award).
